signature.name: VTask.map
signature.type: {R : Type uR} -> {S : Type uS} -> {A : Type uA} -> {B : Type uB} -> {C : Type uC} -> {D : Type uD} -> [CommSemiring R] -> [CommSemiring S] -> [Algebra R S] -> [Semiring A] -> [Algebra R A] -> [Algebra S A] -> [IsScalarTower R S A] -> [Semiring B] -> [Algebra R B] -> [Semiring C] -> [Algebra R C] -> [Algebra S C] -> [IsScalarTower R S C] -> [Semiring D] -> [Algebra R D] -> (f : A →ₐ[S] C) -> (g : B →ₐ[R] D) -> TensorProduct R A B →ₐ[S] TensorProduct R C D

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.map is a total function; it has no junk-value or edge-case conventions — every pair of algebra homomorphisms f and g yields a well-defined algebra homomorphism on the tensor product.

facts.statement: ∀ {R S A B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S] [Algebra R S] [Semiring A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S A] [IsScalarTower R S A] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B], VTask.map (AlgHom.id S A) (AlgHom.id R B) = AlgHom.id S (TensorProduct R A B)
